# Naveen Havannavar for Pittsford

> Campaign site for Naveen Havannavar, Deputy Supervisor and Town Board member in the Town of Pittsford, New York. Elected November 2023, serving since January 2024, and on the ballot Tuesday, November 2, 2027.

## Record (highlights)

- Led the increase in the senior property tax exemption from 50% to 65%, adopted unanimously in February 2026, for seniors with household incomes under $49,000.
- Secured $265,000 in state funding, with Assemblymember Jen Lunsford and Senator Jeremy Cooney, to make King's Bend Park accessible for people of all ages and abilities.
- Brought a property tax exemption for fully disabled veterans to the Town Board; adopted unanimously in October 2026.
- Delivered online dog license renewal, AI safety training for Town employees, an ADA-compliant playground at King's Bend Park, and park bathrooms open in winter.
- Worked on a Town Code update: cluster zoning to preserve green space, viewshed protections, green infrastructure for parking lots, mixed-use development on Monroe Avenue, senior housing options, home businesses and in-home childcare, and expanded residential solar.

## Background

- Software Engineering Manager at Paychex; previously Engineering Manager at Xerox; co-founded two Rochester technology startups.
- MBA in Systems and Marketing; BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics and Physics; Leadership Rochester graduate.
- Statewide Advisory Committee, Coalition for Asian American Children and Families; Community Advisory Board, WXXI/Little Theatre; Past Chair, India Community Center of Rochester.
- Rochester Business Journal Forty Under 40; U.S. patent holder.
- Lives in Pittsford with his wife Kate and their two children, who attend Park Road Elementary.
